title: Etsy Marketplace Insights as First-Party Demand Oracle
body: Once the Etsy shop exists, use Etsy Marketplace Insights as a primary research input where accessible: real Etsy search terms, recent search volume, related terms/trends and listing competition. Use limited free research capacity efficiently; if a paid Etsy tier would materially improve research, present exact cost and expected value for owner approval.
note: Etsy Marketplace Insights needs the shop (owner action 2)

title: Search-Arbitrage and Competitive-Weakness Scoring
body: Score each micro-market using demand, competition/listing density, quality of current offers, pricing/AOV, season timing, Brambleloop differentiation, machine verifiability, support burden and expected contribution. Explicitly hunt meaningful demand where competitors have weak thumbnails, poor PDFs, no video, confusing instructions, weak branding/bundles, stale aesthetics, limited sizes or recurring complaints.
note: radar/opportunity.py scores demand/competition; no competitive-weakness dimensions (weak thumbnails, poor PDFs, no video, complaints)

title: Product Selection Tournament
body: Do not fully engineer the first ideas. Generate roughly 75-100 inexpensive concepts -> research about 40 -> develop stronger commercial/visual propositions for about 20 -> prototype/digital-twin about 10-15 -> fully release only the strongest 5-10. Every stage has a kill gate. Concentrate engineering cost only after commercial evidence improves.
note: radar selects an 11-SKU portfolio from a 34-concept pool; no staged 75-100 -> 40 -> 20 -> 10-15 -> 5-10 tournament with per-stage kill gates

title: Pre-Production Demand Validation
body: Where platform rules permit, test truthful concepts/aesthetics on Pinterest, social and owned channels before expensive engineering. Clearly identify concepts and do not imply an unavailable item is a finished purchasable product. Never use fake Etsy listings, fake purchases or fabricated engagement.
note: pre-production demand validation on owned channels

title: Fast Lane and Flagship Lane
body: Operate two production queues after core QA stabilizes. FAST LANE: lower-complexity Class A/B products such as ornaments, coasters, mug rugs, selected hats, simple decor and suitable simple amigurumi for rapid learning/search coverage. FLAGSHIP LANE: premium blankets, major collections, selected garments and sophisticated seasonal products for authority, content depth and AOV. Both retain all applicable quality gates.
note: fast lane / flagship lane as separate production queues

title: Christmas 2026 Strike Team
body: As soon as real Market Radar is available, score Christmas micro-markets immediately: ornaments, stockings, tree skirts, blankets, pillows, runners, gift bags, hats, amigurumi, quick gifts and bundles. Select from current evidence. Do not allow infrastructure perfectionism to consume the seasonal making window.
note: superseded by 33; radar has shopping-window arithmetic and Christmas concepts, but no seasonal engine

title: Premium Value Stack
body: Flagships compete as complete project systems: polished PDF, written instructions, charts, progress visuals, print version, video/tutorial where useful, yarn substitution/colour guidance and version-aware AI pattern support. Price the customer outcome rather than page count.
note: PDF, written instructions, charts exist; no video, yarn substitution guidance or version-aware AI support

title: Proof Stack
body: Every flagship should accumulate progressively stronger proof: deterministic validation -> independent reverse compilation -> physical tester examples -> real customer projects/reviews -> repeat purchases. Marketing must distinguish proof levels honestly. Use tester/customer photos only with appropriate permission.
note: quality/confidence.py separates arithmetic from physical confidence; no customer/review proof tiers

title: Creator and Tester Distribution
body: Build a legitimate creator/tester seeding database with specialty, audience fit, reliability, engagement and permissions. Use it for independent physical proof, finished photos, colour variations, crochet-alongs, disclosed affiliate partnerships and real audience exposure. Never require or purchase dishonest reviews.
note: creator/tester seeding database

title: Free-to-Paid Acquisition Engine
body: Build owned SEO/Pinterest funnels around useful free motifs, mini patterns, tutorials and tools that demonstrate Brambleloop quality and lead naturally to premium singles/collections. Track visitor -> consented email -> first purchase -> repeat purchase -> collection purchase. Free content must have a commercial job.
note: free-to-paid acquisition funnel

title: First 100 Customers Program
body: Treat the first 100 legitimate buyers as a deliberate validation cohort. Track acquisition source, search term where available, product, price, conversion context, support issue, refund, review, repeat purchase and cross-sell. The goal is to discover what real Brambleloop buyers value and which acquisition loops repeat.
note: needs real customers; schema and cohort machinery buildable now

title: Customer LTV and Cohorts
body: Track first product, subsequent purchases, category affinity, time to repeat, AOV and lifetime contribution where platform/data rules permit. Segment owned audiences by demonstrated interest. Optimize customer lifetime contribution, not only single-listing revenue.
note: needs real customers; schema and cohort machinery buildable now

title: Offer Engineering
body: Test offers as well as designs: single pattern, pattern+video, mini bundle, complete collection, beginner-support package and seasonal bundle. Measure contribution per visitor and revenue per buyer. A winning design with a weak offer should be fixed before being discarded.
note: offer engineering (bundle/video/support variants as testable offers)

title: Conversion Benchmark Engine
body: Build internal baselines by category, traffic source, price band and shop maturity for impressions-to-click, favourites, conversion, refunds/support and contribution per visitor. Do not compare a CA$6 ornament and CA$15 blanket as if they share the same funnel.
note: conversion benchmark engine by category/source/price band

title: First-Page SERP Laboratory
body: For target Etsy queries, periodically capture legitimately observable search-result sets and score thumbnail composition, price/sale presentation, social-proof signals, pattern+video positioning, category diversity and Brambleloop differentiation. Treat observed rank as directional/contextual rather than absolute.
note: SERP capture needs the browser/vision capability (same gate as MJs)

title: Listing Experiment Discipline
body: Record hypothesis, pre-period, treatment, exposure, outcome and confounders. Change one primary variable at a time where practical. Maintain experiment memory so disproven ideas are not repeatedly tested.
note: listing experiment discipline + experiment memory

title: New-Shop Trust Accelerator
body: Before scaling ads, complete the shop: premium icon/banner, About, policies, sections, coherent thumbnails, clear digital-download expectations, truthful product information and rapid support. Accumulate legitimate tester/customer proof. Never manufacture reviews.
note: brand/storefront exists and passes its checks; no trust-accelerator sequencing before scaling

title: Customer-Service Conversion Advantage
body: Target response in minutes when automation can safely answer from canonical data. Pattern Help must know the exact purchased version. Measure whether fast support reduces refunds and improves genuine reviews/repeat purchase. Escalate uncertainty instead of hallucinating.
note: support/concierge.py answers from the exact released version; no response-time targets or refund-impact measurement

title: Promotional Science
body: Use genuine time-bounded sales/coupons/order minimums only when policy-compliant. Measure incremental conversion, AOV and contribution, not merely revenue lift. Avoid conditioning the catalogue to require permanent discounts.
note: commerce/pricing.py refuses deceptive discounts; no promotional science

title: Owned-Audience Compounding
body: Every flagship should have an owned acquisition counterpart: SEO article/tutorial, Pinterest cluster, video where useful and consented email path. Track assisted conversions. Reduce long-term dependence on Etsy for every visit.
note: content ecosystem exists per product; no owned-audience compounding

title: Creator Micro-Seeding
body: Start with small legitimate collaborations and disclosed affiliate arrangements where appropriate. Measure attributable traffic, conversion, usable proof assets and support impact before scaling creator spend.
note: creator micro-seeding

title: Bestseller Replication Protocol
body: When a SKU becomes a statistically credible winner, temporarily reallocate substantial research/creative capacity to understanding WHY: theme, category, technique, low-sew/no-sew, aesthetic, season, price, thumbnail, video, buyer intent and bundle opportunity. Run adjacent controlled experiments without cloning the same product.
note: bestseller replication protocol

title: Numeric Scale/Kill Framework
body: Learn baselines for CTR, conversion, contribution per visitor, refund/support rate and paid CAC. Weak CTR -> thumbnail/title intervention. Strong CTR/weak conversion -> offer/trust/price. Strong conversion/low traffic -> distribution investment. High sales/high support -> QA before scaling. Learn thresholds from real data.
note: numeric scale/kill framework; thresholds need real baselines

title: Revenue and Contribution per Visitor
body: Make Revenue per Visitor and Contribution per Visitor first-class metrics. A higher-priced product with slightly lower conversion may be commercially superior to a cheap product. Pricing, SEO and paid-media agents optimize contribution economics rather than conversion rate alone.
note: revenue and contribution per visitor as first-class metrics

title: $3K Run-Rate Decomposition
body: Express CA$3,000/month as solvable funnel math: e.g. 200 orders x CA$15 AOV, 150 x CA$20, or 120 x CA$25. Then derive required qualified visits from observed conversion. Every weekly review identifies the largest constraint: traffic, CTR, conversion, AOV, repeat rate, product coverage or margin.
note: run-rate decomposition and Monte Carlo trajectory simulator

title: CA$3K Trajectory / Monte Carlo Simulator
body: Once enough real data exists, run nightly scenario analysis using listing count, qualified traffic, CTR, conversion, AOV, repeat rate, organic growth, paid CAC, product velocity, winner rate and retirement rate. Show assumptions/sensitivity and identify the primary constraint. Do not present modeled probabilities as objective truth.
note: run-rate decomposition and Monte Carlo trajectory simulator

title: 75-90% Confidence Gate
body: Brambleloop may only report 75-90% modeled confidence of reaching/sustaining CA$3,000/month when evidence includes multiple independently selling SKUs rather than one viral outlier; positive contribution margin; stable pattern-quality/support metrics; repeatable qualified traffic; observed conversion over meaningful samples; at least one repeatable acquisition channel; improving legitimate review/trust base; no platform-policy warnings; and a scenario model whose conservative assumptions still approach the target.
note: confidence gate (superseded for CA$5K by 230/275)

title: Conditional Scale Rules
body: Strong conversion + low traffic -> increase distribution. High traffic + weak CTR -> thumbnail/title. Strong CTR + weak conversion -> offer/trust/price. Sustainable paid CAC below allowable CAC -> scale gradually. Rising support/refund defects -> stop scaling and investigate.
note: conditional scale rules

title: Anti-Fragility Rule
body: Do not allow one SKU, one holiday, one traffic source, one AI provider or one marketplace to become an existential dependency. Diversify after a channel/product is understood, without spreading resources so thin that nothing gets enough focus.
note: radar portfolio constraints prevent single-season concentration; no explicit anti-fragility dependency rule

title: Growth Resource Allocation
body: After core engineering stabilizes, prevent endless technical polishing from starving distribution. Mature-state conceptual allocation: roughly 30% product/QA, 30% market intelligence/product selection, 30% distribution/growth and 10% infrastructure/operations, dynamically adjusted to the current bottleneck.
note: growth resource allocation model

title: Cost-to-Create and Profitable Throughput
body: Track agent/API minutes and dollar cost per concept, validated pattern, PDF, listing, video asset, support case and acquired customer. Optimize validated products per operating dollar and contribution profit per operating dollar. A six-figure store that burns more than it earns is failure.
note: finance/books.py tracks cost; no cost-per-artifact throughput metrics

title: Replace the narrow Christmas Strike Team with a permanent 365-Day
body: Seasonal Revenue Engine Christmas remains the immediate campaign because the current September 2026 making window is open, but Brambleloop is not a Christmas business. The system must continuously operate an evergreen base plus rolling seasonal waves plus trend opportunities plus breakout amplification. Three simultaneous planning horizons: NOW / MONETIZE — products customers are actively searching for; NEXT / BUILD — events whose shopping/making windows open soon; LATER / RESEARCH — events that need product engineering, indexing and audience-building months in advance. Seasonal universe: Christmas and winter; Valentine's Day; Easter; Mother's Day; Father's Day; weddings; baby showers; births/nursery; graduation; teacher gifts; spring/garden; summer/cottage; Canada Day; July 4 where commercially relevant; back-to-school; fall/autumn; Halloween; Canadian Thanksgiving; U.S. Thanksgiving; birthdays; housewarming; and other evidence-backed occasions. Opportunity allocation: do not give every event equal resources. Score expected demand × achievable visibility × contribution potential × time remaining × product fit × competitive weakness × production feasibility. Allocate creative, engineering and growth capacity dynamically from those scores. Making-date intelligence: each event stores design deadline, engineering deadline, physical-test deadline where required, publication/indexing date, expected search-growth window, peak purchase period and practical last-making date. The system should never discover Valentine's demand on February 1 or Christmas demand in December and call that timely. Dynamic seasonal squads: the Seasonal Revenue Director may spin up temporary Christmas, Halloween, Valentine's, Easter, Mother's Day, Fall/Thanksgiving, Summer/Patriotic, Wedding/Baby and other squads when forecasted opportunity warrants them. Squads deactivate when their marginal opportunity falls below alternatives; they are not permanent token-burning agents. Evergreen floor: seasonal campaigns may receive aggressive temporary allocation, but evergreen production never drops to zero. Maintain products in durable categories such as baby, animals/amigurumi, blankets, accessories, garments, bags, gifts and home decor to smooth revenue between peaks. Cross-season reuse without cloning: validated construction primitives, production tooling and commercial lessons may be reused across seasons, but creative expression must remain original. A successful Halloween product may teach Brambleloop that low-sew mini amigurumi converts; that insight can inform Christmas or Valentine's concepts without simply recolouring the same protected design. Seasonal portfolio dashboard: show each event's days to making-window open/close, active SKU count, candidate concepts, qualified traffic, conversion, revenue, contribution, inventory of release-ready products, content readiness and current capacity allocation. Breakout Product Emergency Mode: if a seasonal or evergreen SKU materially exceeds its category/shop velocity baseline, temporarily override normal production allocation. CEO, Growth, Pricing, Content and Collection agents investigate why it is breaking out, expand legitimate distribution, create high-confidence adjacent experiments and bundles, and protect quality. QA gates remain non-bypassable. Exit emergency mode when marginal opportunity normalizes. Immediate 2026 application: Christmas should receive urgent attention now because the making window is active, while the NEXT and LATER horizons simultaneously prepare winter/Valentine's and subsequent spring/Easter/Mother's Day opportunities. The exact allocation must come from current market evidence, not a fixed percentage. Merge instruction: when this queued upgrade package is given to Claude, replace any architecture that treats 'Christmas Strike Team' as the permanent seasonal strategy with this 365-Day Seasonal Revenue Engine. Preserve Christmas as the current campaign, not the company identity. BRAMBLELOOP QUEUED MASTER UPGRADES v1.3.2 — Adversarial Commercial + Policy Audit These upgrades extend v1.3.1. They were added after another adversarial audit focused on Etsy policy freshness, evidence quality, autonomous-agent thrashing, customer lifecycle, financial discipline and business continuity.

title: Stagnation / Thrash Detection
body: Any agent that observes three materially identical states without progress must stop polling and re-plan. Repeated identical tool call + identical result triggers a circuit breaker. Polling backs off exponentially. Deployment retries require a changed hypothesis/root-cause fix. Track progress-per-dollar and progress-per-iteration; suspend loops consuming budget without state change.
note: stagnation/thrash detection and circuit breaker

title: Etsy Creativity / AI Disclosure Gate
body: Before every Etsy release, classify the product under current Etsy Creativity Standards and generate required disclosures. Etsy permits seller-designed digital downloads and seller-prompted AI creations, but AI use must be disclosed where required. Policy Agent must re-fetch current policy before enabling new asset/product classes. Never assume an AI-generated lifestyle image satisfies Etsy's listing-image requirements.
note: Etsy creativity/AI disclosure gate

title: Evidence-Backed Listing Imagery Policy
body: Separate product proof from promotional concept imagery. For patterns, prioritize real tester/customer finished-project photography as soon as available. Store provenance, consent/license, pattern version, yarn/colour and whether image is physical, simulated or AI-assisted. If current Etsy policy requires seller-owned photos/video or restricts renderings for the relevant listing class, the Policy Gate blocks incompatible assets.
note: gates/asset_truth.py has provenance and the B-097 disclosure rule; no consent/licence/physical-vs-simulated policy routing

title: Marketplace Insights Query Budgeter
body: Marketplace Insights becomes a scarce first-party research resource. Allocate keyword queries using expected information gain: validate the highest-uncertainty/highest-value micro-markets first. Store every query/result snapshot so the same keyword is not wastefully re-queried. Etsy Plus/unlimited access is an owner-approved upgrade only when expected value exceeds cost.
note: Marketplace Insights query budgeter; needs the shop

title: Trend Data Provenance and Geography
body: Every trend/search datum stores source, date range, geography/population and freshness. Etsy trend reports can be based on specific populations/time windows, so agents may not present U.S.-only or historical trend data as current Canadian/global demand. Opportunity scores discount stale or mismatched evidence.
note: radar observations carry observation dates; no geography/population or freshness discounting in the score

title: Policy Freshness Watch
body: Policy Agent performs scheduled checks of Etsy Seller Policy, Creativity Standards, listing-image rules, advertising rules and shilling/review rules. Material policy changes create a blocking incident for affected workflows until reviewed/tested. Store policy version/date with each release certificate.
note: policy freshness watch

title: Product Rights / Commercial-Use Terms
body: Each Brambleloop pattern must carry explicit customer-use terms chosen deliberately: what the buyer may do with the PDF, whether finished physical items may be sold, redistribution prohibition, and support/version policy. The terms must be consistent across PDF, listing and FAQ and should be legally reviewed before relying on them as enforceable.
note: product rights / commercial-use terms

title: Refund / Chargeback / Case Prevention
body: Design digital-product messaging to prevent mistaken purchases: prominent 'DIGITAL CROCHET PATTERN — NOT A FINISHED ITEM', skill level, required materials, terminology and download/support instructions. Track confusion-driven contacts/refunds as a conversion-quality defect. Customer Experience prioritizes resolution before Etsy's case window where applicable.
note: listing copy says digital pattern; no refund/chargeback prevention programme or confusion-defect tracking

title: Pattern Version Delivery System
body: Every sold product maps order -> pattern_id -> purchased version -> current safe version. When a material correction occurs, identify affected buyers and prepare policy-compliant update communication. Support always answers against the buyer's version and can explain migration to the corrected version.
note: support answers against the purchased version; no order->version map or affected-buyer identification

title: Tester Capacity Marketplace
body: Treat physical testing as a schedulable constrained resource. Forecast upcoming Class B/C testing demand, maintain tester reliability/specialty scores, avoid one tester becoming a bottleneck, and schedule seasonal products early enough that physical QA does not miss the making window.
note: quality/physical.py records samples; no tester capacity marketplace

title: Brand Moat Beyond the Model
body: The recurring fictional model is one brand asset, not the brand itself. Build recognizable Brambleloop signatures: editorial layout, naming architecture, photography language, chart style, tutorial voice, collection families, customer-support experience and distinctive original design grammar. The shop must remain recognizable even on product-first listings without the model.
note: brand system exists; no explicit moat inventory beyond the model

title: Product Cannibalization / Bundle Attribution
body: When adding adjacent products and bundles, measure whether they create incremental revenue or merely move buyers from a higher-contribution SKU. Attribute bundle uplift, attach rate and cannibalization before declaring Winner Amplification successful.
note: cannibalization / bundle attribution

title: Price Elasticity Memory
body: Pricing experiments build a category-specific elasticity history. Record price, sale state, traffic source, season, conversion, AOV and contribution. Avoid interpreting seasonal traffic changes as price effects. Use genuine regular prices and truthful temporary promotions.
note: price elasticity memory

title: Zero-Sale Diagnostic Ladder
body: For new products with no sales, diagnose sequentially: insufficient impressions -> query/distribution; impressions/no clicks -> thumbnail/title; clicks/no favourites/cart -> product appeal; favourites/cart/no purchase -> price/trust/offer; purchases/refunds/support -> product quality. Do not retire a product before enough exposure exists to identify the stage failing.
note: zero-sale diagnostic ladder

title: Launch Cohort Holdout
body: Where practical, maintain small organic/control cohorts before scaling paid promotion so the system can distinguish genuine listing/product improvement from traffic purchased by ads. Record assisted versus direct outcomes.
note: launch cohort holdout

title: Cash-to-Growth Reinvestment Policy
body: Revenue does not automatically become ad budget. Define a cash reserve, tax reserve, operating reserve and reinvestment envelope. CFO can recommend reinvestment based on marginal contribution and confidence, but consequential increases remain owner-gated.
note: cash-to-growth reinvestment policy

title: Single-Point Dependency Map
body: Continuously map dependencies: Etsy account, Railway, Postgres, model providers, GitHub, domain/email, payment rails, tester network and key traffic channels. Each critical dependency gets backup/export/recovery strategy proportional to business impact.
note: BUILD_1_BASELINE.md maps dependencies by hand; not a live map

title: Business Continuity Export
body: Nightly or scheduled exports preserve CIRs, PDFs, charts, listing copy/assets metadata, customer-support knowledge, competitor snapshots, experiments and financial ledger in portable formats. The company must be reconstructable if a SaaS provider disappears.
note: core/continuity.py exports every table as portable JSON Lines with per-table sha256, restores into any SQLAlchemy engine, and prove_restore() re-exports the restored database and compares digests -- a row count would pass a restore that mangled every value. Scheduled daily as the continuity_proof cadence; the ops.continuity handler raises a P1 incident when the proof fails. Remaining: the archive is written to ephemeral container storage, so durable object storage is an owner decision (batched). Rendered PDFs/charts are re-derivable from CIR + code and are deliberately not archived.

title: Quality-Adjusted Release Velocity
body: CEO dashboard tracks releases/week only alongside defect rate, support burden, conversion and contribution. Never reward agents for shipping more SKUs if quality or economics deteriorate.
note: quality-adjusted release velocity

title: Stop-Doing Queue
body: Every weekly strategy review produces not only new work but a STOP list: experiments to end, agents/cadences to reduce, products to stop polishing, queries not worth monitoring and infrastructure work with insufficient commercial value. This prevents autonomous bureaucracy.
note: stop-doing queue

title: Pre-Etsy Launch Readiness Gate
body: Before asking owner to open/connect live Etsy operations, require: brand/name clearance checkpoint; storefront asset pack; at least several release-ready products with truthful proof status; policies/FAQ; digital-item disclosure language; customer-support knowledge; pricing/promotion plan; launch calendar; analytics baseline; exact owner setup checklist; and rollback plan.

body: Track confidence in stages rather than jumping from zero to 75-90%. Architecture confidence -> product-quality confidence -> demand confidence -> conversion confidence -> acquisition confidence -> repeatability confidence. The 75-90% modeled band requires evidence across all layers, not merely a Monte Carlo output.
note: confidence evidence ladder (superseded for CA$5K by 274)

title: Separate Evidence Assets from Conversion Assets
body: The deterministic twin/chart layer produces truthful EVIDENCE ASSETS, not automatically customer-facing sales creative. Create explicit classes: ENGINEERING_EVIDENCE, CUSTOMER_INFORMATION, CONVERSION_CREATIVE and PHYSICAL_PROOF. A technically correct chart cannot be promoted to hero/listing creative merely because it rendered successfully.
note: AssetClass exists with 5 classes; needs ENGINEERING_EVIDENCE / CUSTOMER_INFORMATION / CONVERSION_CREATIVE / PHYSICAL_PROOF semantics

title: Listing Asset Promotion Gates
body: Every asset passes four independent gates before customer use: DATA_TRUTH (values match CIR/gauge/version), LAYOUT_QA (no clipping, overflow, overlap, illegible type or contradictory dimensions), COMMERCIAL_QA (the frame has a defined conversion job and is competitive at mobile/search-grid scale), and POLICY_PROVENANCE (asset type/disclosure/rights satisfy current marketplace rules). Failure at any gate prevents listing export.
note: check_frame_plan + check_assets cover DATA_TRUTH and some LAYOUT_QA; no COMMERCIAL_QA or POLICY_PROVENANCE gate

title: Automated Visual Layout QA
body: Add deterministic bounding-box and safe-area tests for title truncation, chart/text collision, footer overlap, edge clipping, minimum font size, mobile crop, aspect ratio and whitespace. Render every listing frame at target Etsy dimensions and at a small mobile preview. Text or charts crossing reserved regions is a test failure, not an aesthetic opinion.
note: LISTING_NO_FONT, LISTING_HERO_FABRIC_FLAT and the thumbnail check exist; no bounding-box/safe-area/mobile-crop suite

title: Dimensional Consistency Auditor
body: Every displayed measurement must trace to one canonical measurement object. Detect contradictory or contextless dimensions such as a finished-size card showing 90×122 cm alongside an unexplained 180 cm marker. Labels must identify width, length, circumference, component, blocked state and size variant where relevant.
note: geometry.py is the canonical measurement object and refuses what it cannot measure; no cross-frame dimensional consistency auditor

title: Visual Semantic QA
body: The system must test whether an image communicates what its caption/title claims. A finished-result frame cannot be only abstract horizontal rows. A chart preview must look like a chart preview. A size card must communicate scale clearly. Use independent visual review plus deterministic metadata assertions; do not rely on the generator grading itself.
note: visual semantic QA -- does the image communicate its caption's claim

title: Hero Image Standard
body: The hero's job is desire and instant comprehension, not documentation. It should communicate the expected finished project at search-grid/mobile scale while remaining truthful and policy-compliant. Technical charts, stitch maps and size cards belong later in the listing sequence unless market evidence proves otherwise.
note: hero rules exist (not a concept, fabric not flat); no finished-project comprehension standard

title: Evidence-to-Creative Pipeline
body: Required flow: CIR -> compiled/twin truth -> engineering evidence -> creative brief constrained by truth -> conversion creative -> independent Asset Truth comparison -> layout/commercial/policy gates -> listing export. Creative systems may improve presentation but may never invent motifs, dimensions, texture, construction or included deliverables.
note: the CIR->twin->evidence half is built; no creative brief or conversion creative stage

title: Physical Proof Upgrade Path
body: For products initially marketed with permitted non-physical representations, create an automatic upgrade task when tester/customer physical photography becomes available. Replace or supplement weaker conceptual assets with genuine finished-project proof where rights permit, then measure CTR/conversion impact.
note: physical proof upgrade path

title: Listing Frame Job Map
body: Every frame has exactly one primary commercial job: DESIRE, SCALE, DETAIL, CONTENTS, DIFFICULTY, MATERIALS, SIZING, PATTERN_PREVIEW, PROOF or CROSS_SELL. Frames without a buyer-relevant job are removed. Prevent five technically different images from communicating essentially the same thing.
note: six frames have roles; not a one-primary-job map with filler removal

title: Mobile-First Creative QA
body: Evaluate every listing set as a shopper actually sees it: search thumbnail, phone gallery, first 3 frames, then full gallery. Store screenshots/renders of these contexts during QA. Optimize title-safe area and visual hierarchy for small screens rather than desktop-only output.
note: thumbnail evaluated at 2000px search scale; no phone gallery or first-3-frames context renders

title: Competitive Creative Benchmark
body: Before release, compare the listing set against a current sample of strong products in the same micro-market on measurable dimensions: finished-result clarity, thumbnail stop-power, proof, information density, consistency, video/support proposition and visual polish. Do not copy competitor creative; use the benchmark to reject obviously substandard presentation.
note: competitive creative benchmark needs browser/vision

title: Creative Defect Feedback Loop
body: Track clipping, confusing dimensions, misleading visualization, weak hero, unreadable chart and redundant frames as named defect classes. Every production-discovered visual defect gets a regression fixture, just like compiler defects. Asset-system quality should improve monotonically rather than rediscovering the same layout failures.
note: B-084/085/086 became regression fixtures; no named visual defect classes

title: Technical Asset Honesty Label
body: Internal and customer-facing labeling must distinguish a digital pattern render/chart from a photograph of a physically completed object whenever that distinction is material. Do not use a disclaimer as permission to make a misleading hero; honesty labels complement, not replace, truthful presentation.
note: B-097 labels generated lifestyle imagery; not generalised

title: Listing Set Release Certificate
body: Create a listing-set certificate tied to product/version that records the exact approved asset hashes, frame order, measurement sources, provenance, disclosures, QA results and policy version. Any product revision that changes geometry/claims invalidates affected listing assets until re-certified. body: Maintain a versioned approved reference pack and character bible containing canonical face views, hair/eye descriptors, proportions, makeup range, expression range, wardrobe rules, lighting language and rejected drift examples. Every new model asset is compared against this pack before approval. Updating the canonical identity is an explicit brand-version event, not accidental generation drift.
